data.title: 冬马和纱 · 掌声落下之后
data.description: 演出结束，和纱站在钢琴旁向观众席微微欠身，手指还留着刚才用力的姿势。
data.action: standing beside a grand piano and bowing
data.promptProse: Standing in the stark, blinding white beam of a single stage follow-spot beside a magnificent grand piano, Kazusa bows with formal, rigid elegance toward the darkened auditorium after a triumphant concerto. The cavernous hall is alive with echoes, while her disheveled black hair catches the bright glare against the deep velvet shadows behind her.
data.animaCaption: Stage light reveals her face and the grand piano as she bows.
